top_choice_rationale: GLP-1 is a mature, independently confirmed chain from proglucagon processing and the insulinotropic action of GLP-1(7-36) to incretin-based therapy of diabetes and obesity, with very large clinical impact. P001 puts the award on the discovery of the physiology and active form of the peptide (Drucker, Holst, Mojsov), which matches the citation scope. P002 is acceptable but shifts weight toward long-acting drug development, so it ranks second. No award ranks last because the evidence is strong.
